patterns.note: Full-bleed photographic sections, often split into two columns, dominate the page layout, creating a magazine-like visual flow for product showcases.
Small, uppercase sans-serif labels are consistently used for product categories and calls to action, contrasting with the elegant serif brand name.
A minimalist color palette of black, white, and subtle greys allows the rich, aspirational photography to be the primary source of visual color and interest.
The header transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid black background, while content sections scroll naturally without complex reveal animations.
Product categories are introduced immediately with large, aspirational split-image heroes, setting a tone of high-fashion visual merchandising from the top of the page.

technique_notes: The primary motion effect is an adaptive sticky header that transitions from a transparent, taller overlay to a compact, solid black bar upon scrolling past the initial hero section.

Content is presented through full-bleed, high-quality photographic blocks, often arranged in a two-column grid, with subtle text overlays for product categorization, creating an immersive visual experience.
Typography combines a sophisticated serif for the brand identity with a clean, modern sans-serif for all functional text, maintaining a minimalist yet elegant aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif display font for the brand name, contrasted with small, uppercase sans-serif labels for categories, and a balanced sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements and images with minimal to no corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal whitespace, especially around large image sections, contributing to a premium feel).

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its heavy reliance on full-bleed, aspirational photography as the primary content vehicle, creating a magazine-like, editorial feel. The immediate presentation of product categories through large, split hero images, combined with a refined serif brand font, establishes a strong sense of luxury and style without being overly ornate.
